scope: Full-screen desired-state action from original KDE TaskManager through existing BWM manager; isolated checked dispatcher/mode readback

contract.optionalCapability: fullscreenable: bool; missing=false; invalid type rejects snapshot atomically
contract.scope: ordinary mapped windows, not hidden or pinned, not minimized/special/legacy99
contract.manager: kwin-window.py --native-serialized --expected-generation START --pid PID fullscreen --state on|off ADDRESS
contract.serialization: existing bounded private runtime lock; post-lock skin/identity/capability validation
contract.readback: require result.ok == true and numeric w.fullscreen == 2 exactly when state=true
contract.receipt: hyprctl repl output must equal bwm-r4-fullscreen-ok; exit=0 alone not sufficient
contract.testOnlyProgram: Lua interpreter resolved by CMake inside BUILD_TESTING; passed to fake IPC via --lua/BWM_R4_TEST_LUA

assertions: snapshot capability excludes minimized, special, pinned, unmapped and hidden windows
source rejects invalid capability atomically, defaults missing to disabled and emits capability dataChanged
source requests explicit desired states and emits nothing without capability
original installed ContextMenu.qml fullscreen handler emits true then false; checked verified after re-opening
original grouped menu emits desired true for each of two members
two installed TasksModel instances share the source and run helper/manager against fake IPC: on/on/off reads back false
real generated Lua is executed in a test-only hl table; PID/skin/storage/hidden/pinned guards reject without dispatch
dispatcher result.ok=false and result.ok=true without changing internal mode both reject
repeated desired set is idempotent, followed by explicit unset
native parser requires desired state plus PID/process generation; stale identity and timeout fail cleanly
generic ok, empty, error-prefixed or failed IPC receipts do not count as success
daily fullscreen invocation still uses PID-guarded toggle
